title: fix: add missing space between model name and description in toggle confirmation dialog
author: MarcosFRG
pr_body_excerpt:
## What
Fixes a missing space in the community endpoint toggle confirmation dialog where the model ID and the status description ran together (`modelId?It will…` → `modelId? It will…`).

## Where
`enter.pollinations.ai/frontend/src/components/community-endpoints/community-endpoint-toggle-confirmation.tsx`

## How
Added `{" "}`.

## Why
Pure rendering bug — the `?` literal was glued to the `{endpoint?.disabled` conditional expression with no whitespace, so the description text appeared immediately after the question mark with no separation.

gist.headline: A Little Room to Breathe
gist.blurb: The community model toggle dialog has regained one carefully cultivated pixel of whitespace. Questions and their explanations are on speaking terms again.
gist.summary: Fixed the community endpoint toggle confirmation dialog so a space appears between the model ID question mark and its enabled/disabled status description.
gist.impact: Users toggling community endpoints now see readable confirmation text such as `modelId? It will…` instead of the description running into the question mark.

A small code-plant and a confirmation dialog make the UI context clear; the visual metaphor is that one tiny space restores readability.
